# websocket

```go
import "banyan/websocket"
```

Package websocket provides a WebSocket hub for real\-time event broadcasting to connected clients.

The hub maintains a registry of active WebSocket connections and provides a thread\-safe mechanism for broadcasting events to all connected clients. It handles client registration, unregistration, and message distribution through channel\-based communication.

The package implements the interfaces.WebSocketHub interface and is designed to be used with the gorilla/websocket library for handling WebSocket connections in HTTP servers.

Example usage:

```
hub := NewHub()
go hub.Run()
hub.BroadcastEvent(event)
```

## func [NewHub](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L58>)

```go
func NewHub() interfaces.WebSocketHub
```

NewHub creates and returns a new WebSocket hub instance. The returned hub implements interfaces.WebSocketHub and must be started with Run\(\) in a separate goroutine before use.

<a name="Client"></a>
## type [Client](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L36-L41>)

Client represents a connected WebSocket client. It wraps a gorilla/websocket connection and provides channels for sending events back to the client. Each client has a unique identifier and is managed by a Hub instance.

<a name="Hub"></a>
## type [Hub](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L47-L53>)

Hub maintains the set of active WebSocket clients and broadcasts events to them. It provides thread\-safe client management through channel\-based operations, allowing concurrent registration, unregistration, and broadcasting. The Hub should be started with Run\(\) before accepting connections.

```go
type Hub struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Hub.BroadcastEvent"></a>
### func \(\*Hub\) [BroadcastEvent](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L105>)

```go
func (h *Hub) BroadcastEvent(event types.Event)
```

BroadcastEvent queues an event to be sent to all connected WebSocket clients. The event is sent asynchronously through the hub's broadcast channel.

<a name="Hub.NewClient"></a>
### func \(\*Hub\) [NewClient](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L112>)

```go
func (h *Hub) NewClient(conn interface{}) interfaces.WebSocketClient
```

NewClient creates a new Client from a WebSocket connection. The connection must be a \*gorilla/websocket.Conn. The client is assigned a unique identifier but is not automatically registered with the hub.

<a name="Hub.Register"></a>
### func \(\*Hub\) [Register](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L126>)

```go
func (h *Hub) Register(client interfaces.WebSocketClient)
```

Register adds a client to the hub for event broadcasting. The client will receive all events broadcast to the hub until unregistered.

<a name="Hub.Run"></a>
### func \(\*Hub\) [Run](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L70>)

```go
func (h *Hub) Run()
```

Run starts the hub's main event loop. This method blocks indefinitely and should be invoked in a separate goroutine. It handles client registration, unregistration, and broadcasts events to all connected clients.

<a name="Hub.Unregister"></a>
### func \(\*Hub\) [Unregister](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/websocket/hub.go#L132>)

```go
func (h *Hub) Unregister(client interfaces.WebSocketClient)
```

Unregister removes a client from the hub and closes its send channel. After unregistration, the client will no longer receive broadcast events.
